text.en: With privilege must come responsibility. Financial freedom gives me choices, and I feel a duty to use them to support my peers, take their dreams seriously, and contribute to cultural change. But how do I live out something I feel called to do while I’m still learning what that requires? Education matters. Yet where is the threshold for beginning? Some understanding emerges through action, through offering something and allowing others’ responses to change it. I have sprinted to create an ecosystem of opportunity. Now I want to slow down, do less with greater care, and give what I’ve begun time to develop. I believe opportunity, money, and dreams should keep circulating.
